author: TresSambone
body:
Name(IGN): Poppy_Pop (IGN was TresSambone when banned)

Why I was banned: I was banned for hacking, fly hacking.

Why I should be un-banned:

  I believe that I should be unbanned not only because this was 2-3 years ago, I've matured since then a realized how much of a mistake it is to hack. I do accept what I did and realized that it was wrong, and I wont do it again. I just need one for chance.
